lab.title: An ancient superfood, made simple
lab.text: Celebrities and fitness coaches rave about sea moss as the latest immune-boosting, skin-healing, digestion-friendly supplement — but it isn't new. It's been eaten for thousands of years across coastal cultures. We pair wildcrafted Irish sea moss with organic bladderwrack and burdock root, then standardise every batch so you get the same wholefood minerals in a clean daily capsule.

items.a: Yes. The capsules are made from pullulan (a plant-based tapioca ferment), with no gelatin, fillers or animal products.

items.q: When will I notice a difference?
items.a: Most people take it daily for 4–8 weeks before they notice steady changes in energy, digestion and skin. Minerals build up gradually, so consistency matters more than dose.

items.q: Can I take it with other supplements?
items.a: Generally yes. Because sea moss and bladderwrack are naturally rich in iodine, check with your doctor first if you take thyroid medication or already supplement iodine.
Pregnant or nursing mothers, children under 18, and anyone with a known medical condition should consult a physician before using this or any dietary supplement. Do not exceed the recommended dose.
Keep out of reach of children and store in a cool, dry place. Do not use if the safety seal is damaged or missing.
